  * Para Mascotas: Está formulada para perros y gatos que sufren estrés, miedo, o desorientación por el transporte o cambios de lugar.

Modo de Uso:

  * Se añade al recipiente de agua fresca de la mascota (5 a 10 gotas) media hora antes del viaje y durante el trayecto, 2-3 veces al día, o incluso directamente en la boca si el animal lo permite.

Spray characteristics from nasal spray atomization (https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.01827)
citeturn345academia6 [wordlim: 200] Published: 4.5 years ago; 
Title: Spray characteristics from nasal spray atomization
Authors: James Van Strien, Phred Petersen, Petros Lappas, Leslie Yeo, Amgad Rezk, Sara Vahaji, Kiao Inthavong
Date: Wed May  4 00:28:31 2022

In addition to topical delivery, nasal sprays offer an alternative drug administration route to the systemic circulation, therefore avoiding the need for painful, invasive delivery techniques. Studies on the efficacy of nasal drug delivery to date have been conflicting despite its potential. In particular computational studies, e.g. Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), of nasal spray deposition require realistic initial spray conditions, which are lacking in the literature. This study aims to provide benchmark experimental data for CFD inputs by characterising four different types of commercially available nasal sprays used in an ENT (Ear Nose Throat) clinic. Spray characteristics were obtained via high-speed videography, while droplet size distribution (DSD) measurements were obtained with laser diffraction. Three actuation forces were evaluated, representing the use-case of an average adult, average child and the maximum force applied to the spray device. The results demonstrated that actuation force influenced spray velocity, spray duration, DSD, and breakup length. Quantitative data of Rosin-Rammler diameter distributions, spray cone angles, dispersion angles and breakup lengths were found, assisting computational models with realistic values, thereby improving future CFD studies of nasal spray drug delivery in the nasal cavity.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Evaluacion de un producto a base de aceite esencial de oregano sobre la integridad intestinal, la capacidad de absorcion de nutrientes y el comportamiento productivo de pollos de carne (https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.03728)
citeturn345academia7 [wordlim: 200] Published: 4.6 years ago; 
Title: Evaluacion de un producto a base de aceite esencial de oregano sobre la integridad intestinal, la capacidad de absorcion de nutrientes y el comportamiento productivo de pollos de carne
Authors: Diego Martinez
Date: Thu Apr  7 20:42:43 2022

Eight experiments were conducted to test an oregano-essential-oil-based product (PRO) on performance, gut health, and nutrient absorption capacity in broilers. The first three, up to 14d and without specific challenges, tested the effects on intestinal histology, skeletal integrity, and growth. Other two experiments, up to 28d birds were challenged to induce feed passage syndrome (STR) and test the effect on the antioxidant status and performance, contrasting later the results under a natural challenge in commercial conditions. Finally, in two other experiments, up to 21 d, birds challenged with coccidia were tested to determine the effects on coccidiosis, nutrient digestibility, and feed efficiency (FCR). Corn-soybean-fish meal diets were used. Under healthy conditions, PRO effects were observed on intestinal villus height and surface area, mucosa density and structure, villus to crypt ratio, goblet cells density, mucus production, body weight gain, and FCR (P<0.04), and carcass yield and bone density (P<0.08). Birds affected by STR showed effects (P<0.05) on superoxide dismutase activity, bodyweight gain, FCRE, non-normal feces frequency, bursal diameter, and dysbacteriosis. Birds affected by coccidia showed effects on cocci-positive ratio, cocci microscopic score, oocysts count, bursal diameter, body weight gain, FCR, apparent digestibility of dry matter and crude protein, protein and energy efficiencies (P<0.01), and nitrogen apparent retention (P<0.07). Results showed PRO added value to the diet favoring feed efficiency and performance.
